Requirements Continuation; your immediately preceding action this turn was Fated Circle and at least one enemy failed its save. Frequency once per round, shared with all Continuation follow-ups.

Each enemy that failed or critically failed that Fated Circle save and remains within a 5-foot emanation takes 2d6 fire damage with a new basic Reflex save against your class DC. Damage increases to 3d6 at 17th level. Consume the opening. This does not use or increase multiple attack penalty.

@Damage[(2+floor((@actor.level-11)/6))d6[fire]] — @Check[type:reflex|against:gunbreaker|basic:true]
